_about: Every number the swarm reads. The money authority may not produce the numbers it uses (The People's Money, Ch. 8), so every source here is an outside agency. FRED and the BIS API are used only as transport.

fred_api._about: When the FRED_API_KEY secret is set, every FRED series is also fetched through the FRED API with that key. The keyless file remains in use until both use_from (never before Nov 16, 2026) and a matching comparison (same dated values; layout may differ) from an earlier day, no more than 3 days old, for that exact series/start. After the switch the keyless file is still checked every run. Comparison evidence is recorded in latest.json under fred_api.parity_evidence. Missing, expired or differing evidence keeps comparison mode. Invalid, empty or failed API responses fall back to CSV and remove prior evidence for that source. The Nov 15 reading and monetary-rule calculations are unchanged.
